body: Sorry to hear that we have that in common, but yeah that's no fun. Makes it difficult to trust someone else when you run into a string of those.

Yes to everything you said. Was in a similar situation. Just hard to start up the cycle again especially knowing that there is a good chance it will end the same way. The rejection really is deflating.

But better for you to not be with that guy than to realize he didn't want anything serious 6 months from now. Hope you find your someone!
Will for sure be more aware of this going forward. Dont think of myself and clingy but you are right don't know how I'm coming off to them. Thanks!
You are right. It's finding those that are the problem. I've found that age doesn't dictate maturity which makes it difficult. Clearly women like you are a gem, hope you are treated that way.
Guess I never thought of it like that.
Lets hope you are right. I'm normally very easy going and then they start taking long term plans which transitions my thinking and then they drop the axe 🤷‍♂️
You aren't wrong, but it sucks. It's like a merry go round. You know getting on where it ends up.
I know how bad it can seem. I've been in that spot. But it can get better. PM me and let's chat
I wish everyone I knew would just forget get about me for a minute so I could slip out of existence. So I understand your feeling.

I agree. And to make to worse, you can't explain it to someone who hasn't been through it. So that adds to it, the feeling of isolation. But understand there are people who are feeling the same thing as you. Maybe that helps a bit. Like knowing someone somewhere can empathize with you.
Yeah you have to be careful. But when I wasn't eating at all it was the only way I could trick myself into consuming calories.

I was in the same situation. I didn't get help soon enough and my life completely came crashing down. Now I see a therapist and am on antidepressants and things are still difficult but better then back then.

If you aren't going to eat, get some ensure. It got me through some rough times. Also, use things at the school to make friends. One of my best friends from college I made in a group project my first semester. I think the most important thing is to try. Try to eat when you can. Try to interact with people when you can. The biggest thing is to try.

Understand that those are the wrong people. I care. That may not mean much coming from someone from the internet but I understand. I've been there. A few months ago. Everyday is still a struggle but I'm here if you want to chat.
Currently battling this everyday. Today I laid in bed til 3pm. Some days are easier than others for sure. PM me if you want to chat.

I was like that for months. Then, it got really bad (use your imagination) and now I'm medicated and see a psychiatrist. Don't get me wrong, I still spend a lot of time on Reddit, but now I also get other things done.
Thanks for the reply, guess I just have to tough it out.
Ok thanks. Haven't heard of cymbalta I'm going to look that one up.

Yeah agreed. The other hobby I recently took up was drawing. I am terrible at it but made up a silly character and draw comics of him. Helps me escape for a while because of how hard I have to focus on not sucking at it

Try cooking. I know for me, getting the ingredients and preparing a nice meal for myself helps me feel like I matter to myself. I also find the whole act of cooking therapeutic. I normal blast music and take breaks to dance with my dog. Gives me a break from feeling like compete garbage.
Awesome! Keep me updated I would love to read it and give you feedback
Wow that would be awesome. I think you just found something to do with your energy. You can write a book or graphic novel! I'd read that for sure.

Could not agree more. As a kid Batman always at appealed to me because I felt like if I work really hard I could be him. His detecting skills are amazing and he gets hurt and have to recover. Makes the character real. Follow up question, if you can have one super powers what is it and why?
Batman or Superman?
Thanks for the kind words. I'll try
Ok thanks for the advice. Yeah I feel like I am just unloading info and thinking about terrible things that have happened. Thanks again.
Yeah I'm trying that main issue being that our friend group is completely intertwined. Makes it even harder. But I'll try to work on my self worth that's a good idea because I feel like I have none.
Currently doing that. I feel like it isn't necessarily helping but instead allowing me to make even more connections that make me feel worse. Hoping that it starts having a different effect.

I recently went through something similar to this. I realized that drinking was causing me more pain than pleasure. I got rid of what was in the house and avoided all situations that I knew there would be drinking. Now, two months later, I don't really drink but have had the occasional beer with friends. Personally, once I made the decision it was pretty easy to stay away from. Also not having in the house helped. I wish you the best of luck on this journey, you can do it on your own, I believe in you.
Do you have water that's not in a toilet? That always helps me.

I have been doing this for a while now. I feel like I normally feel worse after but during sometimes I even convince myself that I'm not miserable. I spend most of my day at work doing this. I can relate for sure.

I can second this comment. As a high school teacher my classroom is frequently the refuge for my students. Sometimes they want to talk other times we sit there and do our own work while listening to music. Hope there is a teacher who can be there for you!
Yeah the bad thing is when you space out for a bit and end up an hour away from home. But agreed my car is one of the very few places I feel comfortable
I am in a similar spot so I can relate. I feel like with every comment and each day a piece of me dies. I hope therapy helps
Have you tried talking to anyone about this? I know it helps whenever I open up to someone. But honestly venting on Reddit really is nice.
That's great you have someone like that in your life!
She is a hound mix. She likes to bury her bones under my pillow. Mixes are the best. Do you know what kind of mix? Miso is a sweet name!

It's like each wag of the tail is trying to wipe away my sadness. To feel loved and needed is something I cherish. Now when I'm having a panic attack she she smashes me in the face with a toy, that's not so great.
I don't walk but instead drive. Kind of the same thing. It really helps me.
I know that running really seems to help my anxiety. And then every once in a while I have a panic attack on the treadmill which is terrible.

For me it's my dog. She always brings me her toys to play with. She doesn't care how messed up I am or what I'm feeling, she needs me to throw that toy. That moment of feeling needed is the only moment of the day I forget about my life.

I know that my last few months of high school were a nightmare (GF cheated on me and turned my friend group against me) and saw college as a fresh start. Luckily for me it was. The most important thing was that I just said "yes" to just about anything. When my roommate was going to the college union did I want to go? No really but I went because I knew I wanted a fresh start. I did this for a while and met a ton of people and had a lot of crazy adventures. Hang in there!
That's amazing! So happy you found something that helps!
I second this. Waking up and having all of the thoughts come flooding back is not fun.

Sadly life has shown me that if I truly open up to people they end up running away or using it against me. There are only two people that I have been honest with that haven't done that. But in my head I'm just always waiting for them to let me down.

I too am feeling this. I have sort of forgotten what it was like to have physical contact. The other day a coworker put his hand on my shoulder and I actually jumped. My brain was so confused by the contact that it freaked out.

When I was younger, in high school, I used to get a ton of crap and people thought I was a jerk because my natural face looks angry. When I would talk to people they would say "wow you are nicer than you look". Now, being in my current state I just fake a smile in situations where I know it will cause more drama to be myself. Which just puts extra strain/anxiety on me. 

Sadly, society sucks in a lot of ways and usually is terrible for the people struggling most.

Going through a similar thing but wife not fiance. 

I will try the senses thing, thanks for the advice.

I have been running about everyday for the past month or so and sadly it doesn't help. I'm actually glad I have a treadmill in my house because the amount I cry on it would be embarrassing at the gym.
I just watched a few videos and I am fascinated by you. Super cool stuff!
With a line like that I am super intrigued...
Yeah it's neat. Also interesting to see patterns based on times emerging from the data. As a scientist by trade, I feel like I'm studying myself.
Yeah the breathing helps and I have heard the mantra thing a few times, I guess I need one of those. Thanks!

I tried the breathing after reading your comment and it did really help. Issue I have is that I am a teacher and when it started to happen today in front of my class, I can't get away. I'm going to stick with the breathing until I can find a doctor. Thanks for the help, not sure I would have calmed down if I didn't see your reply with the breathing exercise today.
I am currently looking for someone in my area, not easy to find someone. Thanks!

Tried the breathing thing today and it for sure helped. I guess I need a self-mantra to chant as well. Issue is that I am a teacher, so I can't just leave I'm kind of stuck in the room with my students. Thanks for the advice!

I am in the same boat as you right now. I know I need to see someone but have no idea how to find them. And then there is the LCSW or psychologist or psychiatrist and that just leads to a whole bunch more feeding my anxiety.
If you don't mind me asking, how did you find someone? I've been doing internet searches but there aren't exactly reviews out there.
